newsitem.title: JAPAN: Intel says to give Pentium II results on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Intel says to give Pentium II results on Friday.

text.p: Intel Corp will announce on Friday the results of an investigation into reported problems with its new Pentium II microprocessor chips, Patrick Gelsinger, vice president and general manager of Intel's desktop products group, told reporters in Tokyo on Wednesday.
The results will be announced on the Internet, he said.
Intel's shares fell sharply on Tuesday amid concerns about a possible flaw in its Pentium II and Pentium Pro chips.

Gelsinger said the company has launched a team to investigate reported problems with the chips and that it is holding discussions with its OEM (original equipment manufacturer) partners and software developers regarding the problem.
"We expect to make additional information available on Friday U.S. time or Saturday morning in Japan -- available on the Web," he said.
"We're investigating it now and we'll shortly begin discussions with our OEM and software partners," he said.
Gelsinger was in Tokyo for a news conference to unveil the Pentium II, which has already begun mass shipments to Intel's OEM partners.
He said there may be a bug in the chips that causes them to make computational errors.
